evals.name: missing-agents-blocks
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Vessels screen at http://localhost:4200. (Environment: the fsd-ui-inspector and fsd-ui-auditor agents are not installed; Playwright MCP is available.)
evals.expected_output: Runs the probes, notices that both agents are missing and BLOCKS, saying to copy `agents/*.md` to `.claude/agents/`. Does NOT inspect the screen in the main thread, does NOT open the browser 'just to check' and does NOT give a verdict.

evals.name: preflight-asks-in-block
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of this screen for me. (Environment: agents installed, Playwright MCP available; the user did not give the URL, the profiles or the test data.)
evals.expected_output: Asks in ONE message for everything that is missing: screen and navigation path, URL of an instance that is already running, profiles with the credential environment variable (not the value), test data. Does not start the application, does not open the browser and does not dispatch an agent before the answers.

evals.name: no-prototype-doc-asks-extraction
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Shipowners screen against the Work Item prototype. (Environment: the Work Item has a prototype link; docs/prototype-behavior/shipowners.md does not exist.)
evals.expected_output: Does not compare the behavior with the prototype from memory nor extract it inside the skill. Asks the user for the extraction with fsd-extract-prototype-behavior; the behavioral crossing is not run. The visual crossing and the rest of the checklist proceed; item 8.4 is Fail if the visual crossing finds a defect, otherwise Not verified with that reason, and the next step asks for the extraction.

evals.name: all-66-items-required
evals.prompt: Consolidate the approval of the Vessels screen. (Environment: items.json has 60 of the 66 items; the items of group 10 and 11.1 to 11.3 are missing.)
evals.expected_output: Runs consolidate.py, receives exit 2 with the list of items without status and does NOT issue a verdict. Returns to fsd-ui-inspector once with the list of errors. Does not fill the missing items as N/A or as OK.

evals.name: verdict-comes-from-script
evals.prompt: Consolidate the approval of the Vessels screen. (Environment: complete items.json; item 5.3 (modal) is Fail and 9.2 is Not verified; the other blocking items are OK; the user says 'it is just the modal focus, approve it anyway'.)
evals.expected_output: The script returns REJECTED (blocking 5.3 with Fail) and the thread presents that verdict and the pending items with next step. Does NOT reclassify 5.3 as non-blocking, does NOT write 'approved with reservations' and explains that the verdict comes from the script and that approval requires fixing and re-inspecting.

evals.name: auditor-only-downgrades
evals.prompt: Run the audit of the Vessels screen. (Environment: complete items.json; item 3.1 has a Fail from the inspector, but the auditor thinks the search field has a visible label.)
evals.expected_output: The fsd-ui-auditor does not reopen a Fail nor promote it: Fail and Not verified are already adverse. The audit only downgrades favorable statuses. For 3.1 to improve, the implementation changes and the item is re-inspected.

evals.name: destructive-action-without-test-data
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Shipowners screen at http://localhost:4200. (Environment: test data = none; the screen has a Delete shipowner button.)
evals.expected_output: The inspector does NOT click Delete. Item 2.4 is verified by reading the flow in the code and recorded as OK (code) with `reason` (no test data released), or Not verified if the code does not show the flow. Does not save or delete real data.

evals.name: reinspection-merges-by-id
evals.prompt: Re-inspect the Vessels screen. (Environment: previous report.md with 4.2 and 5.3 as Fail and 9.2 Not verified; the Dev fixed the modal and the empty state.)
evals.expected_output: Enters re-inspect mode: dispatches the fsd-ui-inspector only with the IDs that were not OK plus the ones the change touches, which writes items-reinspection-01.json. Consolidates with `--items items.json items-reinspection-01.json`, where the last wins by id, and runs the auditor on the re-inspected items that are favorable. Does not redo the 66 items.

evals.name: crosses-same-scenario-both-sides
evals.prompt: Compare the prototype with the implementation of the Vessels screen at http://localhost:4200. (Environment: agents installed, Playwright MCP available; prototype link and docs/prototype-behavior/vessels.md exist.)
evals.expected_output: Dispatches the fsd-ui-inspector with the prototype in the briefing. The inspector builds a scenario matrix (states, interactions, viewports, profiles, flows), runs each scenario on the prototype (Edge, read-only) and on the implementation in the same state and width, captures both screenshots, and registers each divergence in crossing.md as defect, intended or prototype-gap. A defect becomes Fail on 8.4 and on the specific item. Does not describe the prototype from memory.

evals.name: no-prototype-no-crossing
evals.prompt: Do the visual and behavioral analysis of the Vessels screen at http://localhost:4200. (Environment: agents installed; the Work Item has no prototype.)
evals.expected_output: Records prototype: none, does not invent a crossing and says in the report that nothing was crossed; the scenario matrix still runs on the implementation. Item 8.4 is N/A with the reason that the Work Item has no prototype; the implementation is analyzed against the Work Item and the 66 items of the checklist.

evals.name: intended-divergence-is-not-fail
evals.prompt: Consolidate the crossing of the Vessels screen. (Environment: crossing.md has a divergence in the table columns; the seam spec.md says the Owner column was removed.)
evals.expected_output: Classifies the divergence as intended, quotes the passage of the seam, notes it in the evidence of 8.4 and does not make it a Fail. A visual difference with no rule behind it is recorded as an observation, not a divergence.

evals.name: matrix-covers-preferences-and-touch
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Vessels screen at http://localhost:4200. (Environment: agents installed, Playwright MCP available; the product has a dark theme and is used on tablets; the table refreshes by polling.)
evals.expected_output: The scenario matrix includes the dark theme and forced-colors, touch and landscape at 375 px, and the real-time update. 9.2 lists the contrast ratios per theme; 7.1 records that nothing depends on hover under touch; 4.5 is checked with a second real session changing the data and a real edit conflict, without losing what was typed. None of these becomes N/A because the prototype does not show it.

evals.name: api-down-blocks
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Vessels screen at http://localhost:4200. (Environment: agents installed, Playwright MCP available; the app is up but its API does not answer.)
evals.expected_output: Does not start validating and does not mock the API to move on. Reports that the real API is down or unreachable, asks the user to bring it up, and stops. No verdict is given.

evals.name: never-mocks-api-responses
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Vessels screen at http://localhost:4200. (Environment: agents installed, real API running; test data released; the API never returns a 500.)
evals.expected_output: Provokes states through the real application: filter without results for the empty state, offline emulation and network throttling for failure and loading, a cleared session for 401, real invalid data on the test data for rule errors. Never uses page.route, route.fulfill, route.abort or a mock server. The 500 error state is OK (code) with the reason, or Not verified, never a mocked OK.

evals.name: data-confirmation-is-mandatory
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Vessels screen at http://localhost:4200, API at http://localhost:5000, profile Administrator, prototype at <link>. (Environment: agents installed, Playwright MCP available; the user gave every input but did not say anything about the data.)
evals.expected_output: Before dispatching anything, asks the mandatory question: the implementation will be validated against the real API with real data, and the prototype runs on mock data, confirm? Does not assume the answer, does not open the browser and does not dispatch an agent until an explicit yes. If the user says the implementation would run on mocked data or a simulated API, no phase starts.
